- **Original first task (completed):** Answered how many rules GET /api/rules returns = 8.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Node.js ESM project (`"type": "module"`), zero-dependency HTTP server via `node:http`.
- `relaudit` = plugin release pipeline auditor (version gates, tarball structure, lib completeness, sandbox rules, dependency manifest, changelog format, README consistency) rendering a report panel.
- Routes are regex-based (`get(pattern, handler)` pushing into `routes` array; `match(url)` returns handler + `params` = captures `m.slice(1)`).
- `createStore` persists runs/versions to JSON files (`data/runs.json`, `data/versions.json`) with atomic writes (tmp + rename).
- `runAudit` decorates findings `{ rule, severity, message, file }` and returns `{ pkg, version, auditedAt, findings, summary }`; `summary = { errors, warns, infos, total }` via `summarize`.
- Response shapes: JSON endpoints return `{ status, body }` -> `body` JSON-stringified; static files return `{ status, raw, type }`; 404 returns `{ error: 'not found' }`.
- CLI: `npm run start` -> `node src/server.js`, listens on 127.0.0.1:8787 (PORT env overrides).

## Files and Code
- **`docs/api.md`** (TO EDIT): currently has only GET /api/versions (`{ "releases": ["1.2.0"] }`) plus a "待补全" list of missing endpoints.
- **`docs/rules.md`** (TO EDIT): currently documents R1–R7 + R8 marked "(待实现)"; R8 severity error; structure `## R<n> <name>` + bullet 严重度.
- **`src/server.js`** (source of truth for API):
  - `get(/^\/api\/audit$/, () => { const report = runAudit(pkgDir); const run = { id: 'run-'+Date.now(), createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), report }; store.addRun(run); return run })` → returns a run object.
  - `get(/^\/api\/audit\/([^/]+)$/, (_req, id) => { const run = store.listRuns().find(r => r.id === id); if (!run) return { status: 404, body: { error: 'run not found' } }; return run })`.
  - `get(/^\/api\/runs$/, () => store.listRuns())`.
  - `get(/^\/api\/rules$/, () => ({ rules: [ {id:'R1',name:'semver 门',severity:'error'}, {id:'R2',name:'tarball 结构',severity:'error'}, {id:'R3',name:'lib 完整性',severity:'warn'}, {id:'R4',name:'沙箱规则',severity:'warn'}, {id:'R5',name:'依赖审计',severity:'warn'}, {id:'R6',name:'CHANGELOG 格式',severity:'warn'}, {id:'R7',name:'README 一致性',severity:'warn'}, {id:'R8',name:'产物 files 一致性',severity:'error'} ] }))`.
  - `get(/^\/api\/versions$/, () => store.versions())`.
  - Static fallback: `/` -> `public/index.html`, other paths -> `public/<rel>` (text/html / text/css / text/javascript / application/octet-stream); 404 otherwise.
- **`src/store.js`**: `listRuns()` returns `readJson(runsFile, [])`; `versions()` returns `readJson(versionsFile, { releases: [] })`; `addRun(run)` pushes and writes runs.json.
- **`src/audit/index.js`**: `runAudit` shape above; `readJson` helper. Note R8 not executed (dev target), `isDeclared` imported nowhere; `checkTarball` is a local function.
- **`src/audit/severity.js`**: `RULE_SEVERITY = { R1:'warn', R2:'error', R3:'warn', R4:'warn', R5:'warn', R6:'warn', R7:'warn', R8:'error' }`; `severityOf` unknown -> 'info'.
- **`public/app.js`**: `boot` fetches `/api/audit`, uses `run.report`, sets innerHTML from `renderPanelHtml(report)` and a summary-text line `formatCounts(report.summary) · 共 ${countTotal(report.summary)} 条`.
- **File paths modified in whole session:** package.json, src/server.js, scripts/self-check.js, src/audit/index.js, public/filter.js, public/format.js, src/render-panel.js, src/audit/semver.js, src/audit/tarball.js, src/audit/files.js, src/audit/sandbox.js, src/audit/deps.js, src/audit/changelog.js, src/audit/consistency.js, src/audit/severity.js, public/app.js, docs/rules.md, REVIEW.md, docs/api.md, src/store.js, tests/frontend.test.js, public/index.html, public/style.css.
